title: Codex Autoping Idle Summary Refresh 2026-06-20
purpose: Fix the Codex autoping watcher so an idle-no-wave state refreshes the durable summary text instead of leaving a stale attention-required message from an earlier wave.
evidence_command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 -m pytest -q mu/tests/tools/test_codex_autoping_watch.py --tb=short && python3 -m py_compile mu/tools/session/codex_autoping_watch.py && python3 mu/tools/checks/check_host_semantics_ratchet.py --json
evidence_delta: (1) The idle-no-wave autoping watcher state writes a neutral durable summary that matches the structured JSON state and selected repo/bus, so tmux AUTO-PING cannot continue displaying an old attention-required failure after the live state is idle. (2) Regression coverage proves the idle branch rewrites a stale summary without launching real Codex, Claude, or tmux. (3) The change is Codex autoping control-plane only and does not touch runtime, substrate, seed, scheduler, registry, projection, or JS parity semantics.

progress_proof_after: The Codex autoping watcher updates both structured JSON state and durable summary text when no active wave/job exists, making the AUTO-PING pane and startup summary agree with the actual idle state after a successful switch or completed wave.
